name: Independent restaurants and food waste (small sample)
description: Only three fictional interviews with independent restaurant owners. Deliberately below the 5-interview threshold, to demonstrate the small-sample warning.
product_idea: An app that helps small restaurants order the right quantities.

hypotheses.text: Small restaurant owners lose significant money to food waste from over-ordering.
Restaurant owners would use an app to track inventory every day.
Supplier minimum order quantities force restaurants to over-buy.
